audit.why: EVEN at 6/10 matches a 50.0% win rate over 26 games and a genuine tank-mirror shape: neither kit kills the other in a straight 1v1, and both cash out in teamfights.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike list gives no cooldowns, and it treats Permafrost as the thing that spikes.
audit.why: Arctic Assault is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s — the longest basic-ability cooldown either champion has, and her only gap-close. Spending it is a 12-to-18-second window where she cannot reach you at all. Permafrost is 1.5s and spikes nothing.
audit.corrected: The countable spike is Arctic Assault being spent, measured against Justice Punch's 11/10/9/8/7s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (a) The whole full layer says 'Trade on the Permafrost cooldown' and 'Track Permafrost before every punch'. (b) The content layer says she 'starts stacking Frost Armor with autos'. (c) Nobody mentions the shatter.
audit.why: Riot on Permafrost: 'Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks', cooldown 1.5. A 1.5-second cooldown is not trackable and is not a window — the resource that gates the stun is YOUR Frost stacks, applied by Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5s) and her autos. Riot on Fury of the North: 'After being out of combat, Sejuani gains Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows... Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage.' Frost Armor comes from being out of combat, not from stacking autos — the page has fused two different mechanics under one name. And the shatter is the reason getting stunned by her is catastrophic, which was never stated anywhere.
audit.corrected: Track your own Frost stacks, not her E. Frost Armor is an out-of-combat buff granting armour, MR and slow immunity. Never be the stunned one — she shatters stunned targets for massive magic damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names a 1.5-second ability as matchup-defining and gives no numbers at all.
audit.why: Arctic Assault 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, Winter's Wrath 9/8/7/6/5s, Permafrost 1.5s, Glacial Prison 120/105/90s, against Justice Punch 11/10/9/8/7s and Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14s.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt around Arctic Assault and Frost stacks.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer says 'Respect the physical damage' and 'your shield does less here', while the content layer says 'most of Sejuani's damage is magic, so the amped reduction softens her trade'. The two halves of the same page tell the player opposite things.
audit.why: Riot explicitly types only one piece of Sejuani's damage — the passive shatter, 'massive magic damage'. Nothing in the kit is typed physical. With the content layer already committed and the one typed source being magic, the full layer's 'physical' framing is the side that is wrong.
audit.corrected: Full layer aligned to the content layer. Also removed 'Anti-heal if he sustains' from loading — nothing in Sejuani's kit heals.

edits.before: Sejuani opens with Arctic Assault (Q) — a charge that knocks me up and lets her start stacking Frost Armor with autos, so level 1 I respect the dash and last-hit at Winds of War (Q) range instead of stepping up into a free engage. She has no hard burst on me, but if she stacks Frost and detonates Permafrost (E) I eat a stun, and her W cleave chunks me while I'm locked. By level 3 with Q-W-E online I get my answer: if she charges in, I channel Shield of Durand and pop the taunt as she commits, then Justice Punch (E) the knockup to peel and drop the lingering tornado on top of her.
edits.after: Sejuani opens with Arctic Assault (Q) — an 18-second charge that knocks you up — so at level 1 respect the dash and last-hit at Winds of War range instead of stepping into a free engage. She has no burst on you, but Winter's Wrath and her autos apply Frost stacks, and at max stacks Permafrost (E) stuns you off a 1.5-second cooldown. Never be the stunned one: her passive shatters a stunned enemy for massive magic damage. By level 3 with Q-W-E online you get your answer — when she charges in, charge Shield of Durand and pop the taunt as she commits, then Justice Punch the knockup and drop the tornado on top.

edits.before: This is a tank mirror — neither of us is killing the other in a straight 1v1, so the lane is a CC-chicken standoff. My taunt into Justice Punch (E) out-trades her single Arctic Assault if she dashes in alone, but I never want to be the one stunned first, because her Permafrost (E) detonation plus a Winter's Wrath cleave chunks me while I'm locked. Shield of Durand helps more here than people expect — most of Sejuani's damage is magic, so the amped reduction softens her trade. At 6 my real spike isn't the duel, it's Hero's Entrance: while she's an immobile tank stuck farming, I flag a sidelane and drop my R knockup-taunt onto a fight she can't rotate to.
edits.after: This is a tank mirror — neither of you kills the other in a straight 1v1, so the lane is a CC-chicken standoff. Your taunt into Justice Punch out-trades a lone Arctic Assault, and her Q is 18 seconds at rank 1, so once she spends it she has no way in for a very long time. What you never want is to be stunned first: Permafrost fires off a 1.5-second cooldown the instant your Frost stacks max out, and her passive shatters a stunned target for massive magic damage. Watch the stacks, not her E. Shield of Durand helps more here than people expect — most of Sejuani's damage is magic, so the amped reduction softens her trade. At 6 your real spike isn't the duel, it's Hero's Entrance onto a fight she is far too slow to reach.

edits.before: Late game both of us stop mattering as solo carries — two immobile tanks who exist to land CC for the team. My value is the flex engage: Hero's Entrance lets me appear anywhere and taunt a backline, which her telegraphed Glacial Prison (R) flight can't match for surprise. In the actual 5v5 it's a wash of which tank lands their AOE stun first — her R is a longer-range pick tool, mine is the surprise drop — so I save R for the counter-engage and let my carries clean up. I don't try to 1v1 her, because that goes nowhere for either of us.
edits.after: Late game neither of you matters as a solo carry — two immobile tanks who exist to land CC for the team. Your value is the flex engage: Hero's Entrance lets you appear anywhere and taunt a backline, which her 1300-range Glacial Prison bola can't match for surprise. In the actual 5v5 it's a wash of which tank lands their AOE stun first, so save R for the counter-engage and let your carries clean up. One rule survives everything: don't be the one stunned, because her passive shatters a stunned target for massive magic damage.

notes: The three content prose blocks (early/mid/late) were written in FIRST person — 'knocks me up', 'I respect the dash', 'my taunt', 'I don't try to 1v1 her'. Every other Galio matchup I audited in this slice is second person, so this looks like a single bad generation rather than a style choice; all three are now second person. Worth grepping champ-data/content/*.js for ' I ' and ' me ' to see whether other matchups drifted the same way. Separately, the phrase 'stacking Frost Armor with autos' fuses two unrelated Sejuani mechanics (the out-of-combat Frost Armor buff and the Frost stacks that gate Permafrost) — if that phrasing appears on other pages it is wrong there too. Galio's Justice Punch still carries the bogus derived 'terrain' flag, which produced a 'Galio can cut your retreat with Justice Punch (E)' row for Sejuani in _missing-interactions.json; ignored, no terrain claim written.
